integrity: Finite rational checks and numerical diagnostics supplement but do not replace the fully stated analytical proof. No independent mathematical assessment.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the independent homogeneous Poisson coordinate-flip plus independent all-coordinate-complement model. Fixed real cutoff-window parameter; arbitrary nonnegative common-clock rates for cutoff only. A previously published quotient-walk result already supplies a related pure-cosh endpoint. Historical priority of the critical interpolation has not been independently certified.
title: Critical rare-antipodal-flip crossover in Boolean-cube cutoff profiles
